items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I had the fortune, the good fortune to meet a man named (Esa El-Sayee.) ... I used to do some teaching with him.

ctx.x: I'm going to ask you about him in a minute.
Okay. So anyway, while I had received my 12 weeks notice, I had the fortune, the good fortune to meet a man named (Esa El-Sayee.) (ISSA EL SAIEH)
